description: This file defines the RowRange class for handling ranges of rows within a worksheet in a PHP spreadsheet library. It provides methods for creating, shifting, validating, and converting row ranges, enabling manipulation of row selections in a spreadsheet context.

classes.name: RowRange
classes.description: Represents a range of rows in a worksheet, providing functionality for range creation, validation, shifting, and conversion to cell ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a RowRange with specified start and end rows, and optional worksheet context.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a RowRange from an array of two integers, optionally associated with a worksheet.

methods.name: validateFromTo
methods.description: Validates and sets the starting and ending row numbers, ensuring 'from' is less than or equal to 'to'.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Returns the starting row number of the range.

methods.name: to
methods.description: Returns the ending row number of the range.

methods.name: rowCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of rows in the range.

methods.name: shiftRight
methods.description: Returns a new RowRange shifted to the right by specified offset.

methods.name: shiftLeft
methods.description: Returns a new RowRange shifted to the left by specified offset.

methods.name: toCellRange
methods.description: Converts the row range to a CellRange object spanning all columns in the range.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the row range, including worksheet context if available.
